bundle.shortDescription: Isolated browser profiles for AI providers
bundle.longDescription: BITS Flow AI manages isolated WebKitGTK browser profiles for AI providers such as Google Flow, Gemini, Suno, and PixVerse. Each account persona gets its own data directory, so provider sessions never mix. All data stays on your device.
